name: Bozrah
overview: Bozrah is identified in Scripture as both a city of Edom and a town of Moab, notable for its association with sheep and significant prophetic declarations. The city of Bozrah in Edom is depicted as a site of divine judgment and sacrifice, where the LORD’s sword brings great slaughter, highlighting His righteous and mighty salvation. Prophecies foretell Bozrah’s desolation and curse, emphasizing the coming judgment on Edom and Moab, and portraying the fear and anguish that will overtake its inhabitants. These passages underscore God's sovereign power to save His people and execute justice upon nations opposed to Him.
